title: Trombone Champ co-creator releases "UFO 50,000," a 2-hour mixtape tribute to the music of UFO 50
excerpt: Are mixtapes still mixtapes if there's no tapes?
content:
Are mixtapes still mixtapes if there's no tapes?

UFO 50, available on Switch right now, is an out-of-this-world collection of 50 single player and multiplayer games that span a variety of genres – from platformers and shoot ‘em ups to puzzle games, roguelites and more. As you journey through the library, make connections and learn more about UFO Soft, the fictional 80s company behind the games, as well as their expansive shared universe that includes sequels and recurring characters.

UFO 50 is also chock-full of original music for each of the 50 games in the collection, and the soundtrack is top-notch from beginning to end. If you enjoy the game’s OST and are looking for an all-new way to experience, a very unique listening experience has been crafted by Trombone Champ’s co-creator.

A two-hour mixtape of UFO 50’s tunes mashed up with hip hop songs has just released, and you can stream it all for free. UFO 50,000, the album posted above, was made by Dan Vecchitto, co-owner of Trombone Champ studio Holy Wow Games. This album has been over a year in the making, and you can find a complete tracklist with timestamps in the YouTube description.
